svg.text: The same two local stars can carry very different global addresses
Six unit triangles merge into each hexagon. All shared edges fit exactly.
Local stars in both tilings: six triangles; or four triangles and one hexagon.
Left: a finite crop of a periodic full-plane tiling. More widely spaced centers give unbounded k.
Right: 27 selected centers in the 8 × 8 address window; Q = 2Q + {(0,0),(1,0),(0,1)}.
The right full-plane tiling has infinitely many vertex orbits. Its center-selection hierarchy is fractal; all tiles stay regular.
